summary.text: Dee Morikawa has represented House District 17 in the Hawaii House of Representatives since being elected in 2011; her legislature biography states that she has served as House Majority Floor Leader since 2018.

paragraphs.text: Morikawa worked for the County of Kauaʻi, including in its Department of Parks and Recreation.
Morikawa attended Kapaʻa High School and Kahuku High School and holds an associate degree in accounting from Kauaʻi Community College.
